destination_type.description:
The destination type to connect, e.g. 'Snowflake' or 'S3'.

* `Redshift` - Redshift
* `Snowflake` - Snowflake
* `BigQuery` - BigQuery
* `Postgres` - Postgres
* `Databricks` - Databricks
* `AzureBlob` - Azure Blob
* `S3` - S3

integration_kind.description: Which integration kind to connect when the type accepts more than one. Only S3 does: 'aws-s3' (the default) or 's3-compatible' for MinIO, Wasabi, R2, GCS and similar.
